question: Ticket 27e5f90dcfa7 touches outline section 11.4.10, where Q#95 stands open: "The usage tool (cairn/tools/usage/usage.py, the orchestrator's usage reading, 11-12) makes one HTTPS GET to api.anthropic.com for the account's usage, by urllib.
